notes.title: Update Notes: Hard mode.
notes.notes:
Hard Difficulty
I've added a second difficulty where the machine is at full aggro from the start, plus a few slight rebalances to make the game more difficult in several additional ways regarding lighting, flashlights, batteries, speed and stamina.
Good luck beating the machine :)

notes.title: Day one Patch!
notes.notes:
Hey people! There were a few confusing bugs I missed that confused people a lot. and I decided to add some quality of life features into the game too, to reduce friction.

Bug Fixes
[olist]
Doors correctly state if they are locked or unlocked now.
The bulb collecting task now tracks fixed bulbs properly, (it missed half before)
Low audio peaking has been fixed, it was caused by a 30hz frequency clip meant to induce anxiety :o
Stamina bar doesn't disappear anymore
Camera doesn't move when reading notes anymore
[/olist]

Updates/Improvements

Flashlight flicker when out of battery made much less obnoxious
moved tasks list to gameplay HUD
made the task prompts more snappy
added text dialogue back into the game


Thank you all for the feedback and support!
